result.summary: Adds proper header declarations and marks file-local functions as static across multiple subsystems, including RPC, REST, Qt, wallet, and script utilities. It removes unnecessary header declarations for functions only used within their translation unit and reorders definitions where needed.
result.problem: Functions with external linkage that lack prior header declarations or rely on ad-hoc local declarations prevent enabling the -Wmissing-declarations and -Wmissing-prototypes compiler warnings.
evidence: PR description notes these are "changes split out of #36743", which aims to enable -Wmissing-declarations/-Wmissing-prototypes build flags
result.scope_notes: Touches 26 files across distinct areas (wallet, script, rpc, rest, qt, tests, fuzzing), mostly making functions static or dropping dead header prototypes.
result.changed_since_previous: Diff inspection confirms specific functions transitioned to internal linkage across wallet, script, rpc, and test files, as well as reordering of main() in bitcoin.cpp to avoid forward declarations.
result.card: Adds missing header declarations and marks translation-unit-local functions static across multiple subsystems, including wallet, RPC, REST, Qt, and tests. This resolves functions lacking declarations or using mismatched local prototypes, preparing the codebase to build cleanly with -Wmissing-declarations and -Wmissing-prototypes compiler warnings. It unblocks PR #36743.

risk.why: Mistakes in function linkage or declarations would result in compile- or link-time errors rather than runtime misbehavior.
